purpose: Construct the L0-v2 scientific TN parent with zero 1961 incremental anthropogenic N, candidate-specific daily canonical hydrologic transfer, finite mineral carryover, station-position Q consistency, and then test one five-attribute process-embedded contact regionalization.

hydrology.historical_1961_2009: deterministic daily reconstruction from the frozen 20260828_9 hydrologic model and 20260824_26 forcing
hydrology.splice: 1961-2009 reconstructed plus 2010-2024 exact canonical daily hydrology
hydrology.andreadis_role: bankfull width/depth only; reference discharge forbidden

monthly_n_timing.rule: registered monthly source and crop-demand masses enter at the beginning of each month; the remaining post-crop mineral stock is then propagated through every frozen daily hydraulic state in chronological order

daily_upper_order: candidate contact with actual daily fast plus percolation water
fast/percolation partition of the same mobilized N mass
fixed mineral other-loss on the nonmobilized remainder
carry remaining mineral N to the next day

mineral_other_loss.interpretation: fixed conservative upper lifetime for short-term mineral carryover; combines denitrification, volatilization, irreversible immobilization not represented in L0-v2, deep loss and unresolved non-river fate

river.hydraulic_exposure: bankfull travel time computed from canonical simulated Q and Andreadis geometry, divided by bankfull depth
river.station_position_rule: upstream inlet plus downstream_fraction_on_reach times local contribution
river.q_consistency: the same station-position canonical Q is used in the concentration denominator and C-Q features

objective: 0.5 station-macro Student-t4 + 0.5 terminal-tree-macro Student-t4 + explicit priors once / J_ref=119
R1_promotion_gate: population temporal OOF must improve or be noninferior to R0 and maximum absolute fitted reach log-alpha modifier must not exceed 1.0; nested LORO/LOTO and natural expansion remain mandatory in 20260824_43 before any mainline lock
